summary: Emergency voice crash protection: restore the verified private Parakeet voice pipeline and pause GTCRN native processing.

changes.title: Fix voice-button keyboard shutdown
changes.detail: Reverted the newly introduced native GTCRN startup and Android input-route probe from the live microphone path after a reported crash within 1–2 seconds. Restored the previously working private PCM capture and Parakeet recognition code.

changes.title: GTCRN paused for safety
changes.detail: The lightweight offline GTCRN weights remain packaged for future verified activation, but are not loaded or run in this release. BR Brain now clearly states the filter is paused instead of showing misleading activity counters.

changes.title: Privacy and existing models preserved
changes.detail: No cloud recognition, network permissions, signing-key changes, or new model downloads. The installed Parakeet 110M and its private data remain untouched. Larger Parakeet Ultra is deferred pending accent-specific accuracy and Oppo stability verification.
